# Design Token Skills

> Design Token Skills is a free, open-source set of 12 Claude Code skills that write a design token system into a Figma file from short typed lines. It creates Figma variables and text styles (not components). MIT licensed. Works on macOS and Linux; Windows is not supported for now. It is an independent project, not affiliated with Figma or Anthropic.

Design tokens are organized in three color tiers, all by reference and never copied hex values: Brand (raw values), Alias (roles such as Primary and Neutral) and Mapped (usage such as Text/heading, with Light and Dark modes). Spacing, radius, border width, motion and a responsive type scale (Desktop and Mobile) sit alongside them.

Requirements: a Claude Code account, Figma Desktop, the Figma Console MCP connection (set up once) and Node.js 18 or newer. No coding and no Git knowledge needed.

## Docs

- [Home](https://designtokenskills.com/): what it does, with a live demo of each skill
- [Designer's Guide](https://designtokenskills.com/guide/): install, mental model, every skill step by step, cheat sheet and troubleshooting

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/manolobevia/design-tokens-starter-kit): the skills, the README with every parameter, tests and the MIT license
- [Connect Claude Code to Figma](https://github.com/manolobevia/design-tokens-starter-kit/blob/main/docs/figma-console-setup.md): one-time setup of the token, the server and the plugin

## The 12 skills (what you type, what it writes)

- figma-color-scale: `Purple:#5C3FC4` writes an 11-step scale (950 to 50) in Brand
- figma-alias-bridge: `Brand/Purple -> Alias/Primary` writes Alias roles that reference Brand
- figma-mapped-roles: `Mapped` writes Surface, Border, Text and Icon variables in Light and Dark, referencing Alias
- figma-spacing: `Spacing` writes a 4px-unit spacing scale
- figma-radius: `Border radius` writes a border radius scale
- figma-border-width: `Border width` writes a border weight scale
- figma-motion: `Motion` writes duration and easing variables
- figma-type-scale: `Typography` writes font variables, a Desktop and Mobile size scale and text styles
- figma-token-docs: `Design Tokens` builds a Design Tokens documentation page in Figma
- figma-contrast-fix: `Contrast fix` finds Mapped pairs below WCAG AA and previews a passing fix
- figma-export-tokens: `Export tokens` writes CSS custom properties, W3C design tokens JSON and a Tailwind v4 theme
- figma-starter: `/figma-starter Plum:#3B1A53 Periwinkle:#8E7FAE heading "Moneta Sans" body Lato` runs all of the above in order
